propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix runs for Gerrit changes 1129/1130/1131/1136 hung at 99% progress for 1.7–4.3 hours because affected revisions omitted blob-prefetch fix 96a0d5c3f, triggering per-blob lazy-fetch through checkout-index on shallow blobless clones

The reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml test job lacks timeout-minutes configuration, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit instead of the documented 10–16 minute normal duration, preventing automatic failure and requiring manual clearing

Test test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract timed out on Gerrit 1129 because FakeJiraClient.search_issues did not respect startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, returning the same non-empty page indefinitely instead of terminating on an empty page

Adding timeout-minutes: 60 to jobs.test in _build-and-test.yml bounds pytest matrix execution and ensures both CI callers (test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml) fail within 60 minutes instead of requiring manual intervention
Fixing FakeJiraClient.search_issues to slice results based on startAt/maxResults parameters restores pagination contract adherence and eliminates the indefinite loop in paged searches
